evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer asked many detailed billing/packing-material questions (TV case, mattress bag, arrival-window confusion) but never raised an emotional concern about the move itself — no concern raised, full credit.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'This is only my estimate. If the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time we used' — matches the 'pay less if beats it' line.

top_strength: Exceptional patience — walked a confused, anxious customer through arrival-window logic, TV-case availability, and mattress-bag costs multiple times without frustration, and still closed the booking.
coaching_note: No damage-coverage (Sheet 1) language despite an extended conversation about wrapping/protecting the TV and mattress — a natural moment to state the $2,000 coverage promise was missed.
